---
title: "How-To cite OpenLB"
---

For references to $\OpenLB$ in general, we recommend to cite the most recent overview paper [@krause:21].
```bibtex
@article{openlb2020,
    author    = "Krause, M. J. and Kummerl{\"a}nder, A. and Avis, S. J.
                 and Kusumaatmaja, H. and Dapelo, D. and Klemens, F.
                 and Gaedtke, M. and Hafen, N. and Mink, A.
                 and Trunk, R. and Marquardt, J. E. and Maier, M.-L.
                 and Haussmann, M. and Simonis, S.",
    title     = "OpenLB—Open source lattice Boltzmann code",
    year      = "2020",
    journal   = "Computers \& Mathematics with Applications",
    doi       = "10.1016/j.camwa.2020.04.033"
}
```

For references to a specific release of the code, each version is associated with a citeable Zenodo publication.
The latest release $\OpenLB$ 1.8 [@olb18] is covered by the present user guide and citeable via:

```bibtex
@Software{olbRelease18,
  author       = {Kummerl\"{a}nder, Adrian and
                  Bingert, Tim and
                  Bukreev, Fedor and
                  Czelusniak, Luiz Eduardo and
                  Dapelo, Davide and
                  Gaul, Christoph and
                  Hafen, Nicolas and
                  Ito, Shota and
                  Je\ss{}berger, Julius and
                  Khazaeipoul, Danial and
                  Kr\"{u}ger, Timm and
                  Kusumaatmaja, Halim and
                  Marquardt, Jan E. and
                  Raeli, Alice and
                  Rennick, Michael and
                  Prinz, Franti\v{s}ek and
                  Schecher, Maximilian and
                  Schneider, Andreas and
                  Shimojima, Yuji and
                  Simonis, Stephan and
                  Sitter, Pascal and
                  Spelten, Philipp and
                  Tacques, Alexandre and
                  Teutscher, Dennis and
                  Zhong, Mingliang and
                  Krause, Mathias J.},
  title        = {{OpenLB Release 1.8: Open Source Lattice Boltzmann Code}},
  month        = apr,
  year         = 2025,
  publisher    = {Zenodo},
  version      = {1.8.0},
  doi          = {10.5281/zenodo.15270117},
  url          = {https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15270117}
}
```

Starting with release 1.6, metadata is also defined in the standardized *Citation File Format* and included as a `CITATION.cff` in the release tarball.
